title: Feathers v1: one theme editor -> Power BI json + Tableau json + Tableau tps
description: Goal: a Power BI or Tableau user builds one theme in the browser (colors, system fonts, gridlines, backgrounds), downloads files for their tool, and imports them by following the on-page guide, even as a first-timer. Static client-side site on GitHub Pages, no sign-in. Out of scope v1: custom fonts, per-visual Power BI overrides, accounts, playfair.com embed.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Power BI json imports in Desktop; palette, fonts, gridlines, backgrounds visible. 2) Tableau theme json imports via Format>Import Custom Theme, <15KB, schema-valid, fonts/gridlines/background/mark-color visible. 3) Tableau tps palettes (categorical/sequential/diverging) appear in Edit Colors. 4) Per-tool import guides: steps, exact path, verify check, common errors. 5) Colorblind + contrast checks, beginner/advanced toggle. 6) Static, sign-in-free, deployed to Pages.

title: Verify default font lists: Tableau theme font-family and Power BI textClasses fontFace
description: Curate the dropdown lists. Tableau: Tableau Book/Light/Regular/Medium/Semibold/Bold (+Black?) plus system fonts; Power BI: Segoe UI family, DIN, others. Confirm each renders when imported (fixtures already use Tableau Book/Semibold and Segoe UI/Semibold).

title: End-to-end verification and first-time-user test
description: Import all three files into real Power BI Desktop and Tableau Desktop; have a novice follow the guides; verify live Pages URL.

title: Beginner/advanced toggle
description: Beginner: shared settings and presets. Advanced: per-element Tableau fonts, raw JSON, hints.

title: Import guides per tool and file (PBI json, Tableau json, Tableau tps)
description: Numbered steps, exact paths/menus, verify-it-worked, common errors (curly quotes, restart, Override vs Preserve, filename/size limits, font installed). tps: paste block, do not overwrite Preferences.tps. Note Tableau theme json vs tps are separate procedures.

title: Accessibility checks: colorblind simulation + contrast warnings
description: Run on user palettes and on the 3 presets; surface honest flags (e.g. Playfair Dark Green vs Dark Red, pastel Lights on white).

title: Previews: Power BI-style and Tableau-style with click-to-edit
description: Live previews react to colors, fonts, gridlines, backgrounds; click an element to jump to its setting.

title: Editor UI: palette, typography (system fonts only), lines, backgrounds panels
description: Drag-reorder colors, palette type selector, curated font dropdown per tool, gridline/zeroline controls, background controls, View JSON.

title: Pre-built presets: Playfair Data, Okabe-Ito, Paul Tol Muted
description: Each with categorical+sequential+diverging variants and neutral roles. Playfair hex values are in the plan file / bd remember. Verify Okabe-Ito and Tol values and licensing from primary sources.

title: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript vanilla app and GitHub Pages deploy
description: Vite TS, Vitest, Pages workflow, subpath base config per static-site-conventions. Keep core embeddable (no framework).

title: Define tool-neutral theme model + 3 exporters (TS) with fixture tests
description: Model: palette (categorical/sequential/diverging), typography, gridlines/zerolines, backgrounds. Mappers to Power BI json, Tableau theme json (15KB cap, filename rules, schema validation) and Tableau tps. Vitest fixtures.
close_reason: Theme model + 3 exporters; 14/14 tests pass incl. validation against published Power BI 2.157 and Tableau schemas, with negative tests

title: Research: verify export formats against real imports
description: Verify Tableau theme json properties vs published schema (help.tableau.com/samples/en-us/custom_themes/CustomThemesSchema_1.0.0.json); exact Tableau Preferences.tps XML; Power BI theme schema surface for dataColors, textClasses, page/canvas background, wildcard visualStyles gridlines/backgrounds; curated default-font lists per tool; check whether Tableau Cloud/Server/Public support theme json. Hand-test one import in each tool.
notes:
